name: @deadair/streamdeck
description: The station on a Stream Deck: what is on air, Skip, and Stop or Start.

scripts.installer: rm -rf artifacts && mkdir -p artifacts/staging && cp -R radio.deadair.streamdeck.sdPlugin artifacts/staging/ && streamdeck pack artifacts/staging/radio.deadair.streamdeck.sdPlugin --output artifacts --force --no-update-check && rm -rf artifacts/staging
